records.source: I'm really excited.$h#$b#I'm going to be your wife. Hehe.$l
records.translation: Sabik na sabik ako.$h#$b#Magiging asawa mo na ako. Hehe.$l

records.source: I need to get mentally prepared for being a farmer's wife.
records.translation: Kailangan kong ihanda ang sarili ko sa pagiging asawa ng isang magsasaka.

records.source: ...$l#$e#I'm a little nervous. But happy.$h
records.translation: ...$l#$e#Medyo kinakabahan ako. Pero masaya.$h

records.source: I've always dreamed of living on a farm.$h#$e#I'm going to be so happy.
records.translation: Noon ko pa pinapangarap na tumira sa isang bukid.$h#$e#Magiging napakasaya ko.

records.source: I'm so happy!$h#$e#It's just like I always dreamed.$l
records.translation: Napakasaya ko!$h#$e#Katulad ito ng lagi kong pinapangarap.$l

records.source: It's okay. I know we can't have a honeymoon, since your farm needs to be taken care of.#$e#I'm a farmer now, too!
records.translation: Ayos lang. Alam kong hindi tayo makakapagpulot-gata dahil kailangang alagaan ang bukid mo.#$e#Magsasaka na rin ako!

records.source: @.. I'm a little scared. This is such a big change!#$e#Don't worry, I'm really happy, too.$h
records.translation: @... Medyo natatakot ako. Napakalaking pagbabago nito!#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, napakasaya ko rin.$h

records.source: We're going to have a little farm family, soon.$l#$e#I'm so glad you feel this way about me.$h
records.translation: Malapit na tayong magkaroon ng munting pamilya sa bukid.$l#$e#Tuwang-tuwa akong ganito ang nararamdaman mo para sa akin.$h

records.source: Hehe. Me? Married? I never thought this would happen.$h#$e#We're going to have a lot of fun together.$h
records.translation: Hehe. Ako? Ikakasal? Hindi ko inakalang mangyayari ito.$h#$e#Magpapakasaya tayo nang husto.$h

records.source: I'm engaged to a farmer. Wow!$h#$e#Our lives are going to be a lot different from now on.$l
records.translation: Nakatakda akong pakasal sa isang magsasaka. Wow!$h#$e#Malaki ang magiging pagbabago sa buhay natin mula ngayon.$l

records.source: I'm going to be really happy as your husband, @.$l#$e#I'm excited.
records.translation: Magiging napakasaya ko bilang asawa mo, @.$l#$e#Sabik na sabik ako.

records.source: I never dreamed this would happen. I'm so lucky.$l#$e#I can't wait till the wedding.$h
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang mangyayari ito. Napakaswerte ko.$l#$e#Hindi ko na mahintay ang kasal.$h

records.source: In a couple days I'm going to be living on a farm. I can't believe it.$h#$e#I'm happy, though.$l
records.translation: Sa loob ng ilang araw, titira na ako sa isang bukid. Hindi ako makapaniwala.$h#$e#Pero masaya ako.$l

records.source: When you showed up in town, I never thought I'd be marrying you some day.$l#$e#Life is strange, huh?$h
records.translation: Nang dumating ka sa bayan, hindi ko inakalang pakakasalan kita balang araw.$l#$e#Kakaiba ang buhay, ano?$h

records.source: Oh my goodness! I have so much to prepare before the wedding! I'm nervous.$l#$e#I'll be relieved after we're all settled in on your farm.$h
records.translation: Naku! Napakarami kong kailangang ihanda bago ang kasal! Kinakabahan ako.$l#$e#Mapapanatag ako kapag maayos na tayong nakatira sa bukid mo.$h

records.source: I'm really happy.$h#$e#This was always my secret wish.$l
records.translation: Napakasaya ko.$h#$e#Ito ang lihim kong hiling noon pa man.$l

records.source: The farm will be such a lovely place to write. I'm really looking forward to this.$h#$e#We're going to make a great pair.$l
records.translation: Magiging napakagandang lugar para magsulat ang bukid. Talagang inaabangan ko ito.$h#$e#Magiging mahusay tayong tambalan.$l

records.source: This is going to be such an adventure! I'm really excited. Aren't you?$h#$e#We can use my cottage as a beach house.$l
records.translation: Magiging isang malaking pakikipagsapalaran ito! Sabik na sabik ako. Ikaw rin ba?$h#$e#Maaari nating gawing bahay sa tabing-dagat ang kubo ko.$l

records.source: @, this is the greatest thing that could have happened.$l#$e#I can't wait.$h
records.translation: @, ito na ang pinakamagandang nangyari sa akin.$l#$e#Hindi ko na mahintay.$h

records.source: I'm going to love being a farmer.$h
records.translation: Magugustuhan ko ang pagiging magsasaka.$h

records.source: Part of me is wondering if this isn't all some elaborate prank.#$e#I can't believe you'd actually want to marry someone like me.
records.translation: May bahagi sa akin na nag-iisip kung pinagplanuhang biro lang ba ang lahat ng ito.#$e#Hindi ako makapaniwalang gugustuhin mo talagang pakasalan ang isang tulad ko.

records.source: @... My head's spinning, and I haven't even had a beer today.
records.translation: @... Umiikot ang ulo ko, at hindi pa nga ako umiinom ng serbesa ngayon.

records.source: Can you believe we're about to move in together? I've never lived with anyone but my family.#$e#It's... exciting.
records.translation: Makapaniwala ka bang magsasama na tayo sa iisang bahay? Hindi pa ako nakitira kaninuman maliban sa pamilya ko.#$e#Ito ay... kapana-panabik.

records.source: I always knew something important would happen between us... I just never thought it would be this!$h#$e#The parrot is excited too.
records.translation: Alam kong noon pa may mahalagang mangyayari sa atin... Hindi ko lang inakalang ito iyon!$h#$e#Sabik din ang loro.

records.source: @... I'm afraid we'll have to keep this a secret... Neither my people nor yours would accept us living together.
records.translation: @... Natatakot akong kailangan nating ilihim ito... Hindi matatanggap ng mga kababayan ko o ng mga kababayan mo na magsama tayo.

records.source: You know I'll be a very strange person to live with, right? I won't be able to leave the house...
records.translation: Alam mong talagang kakaiba akong kasama sa bahay, hindi ba? Hindi ako makakalabas ng bahay...
